name: The Room
texts:
Amazon warrior:
What adventure shall I set off on now?

Amazon warrior:
Just a little ways off from here, in the hinterlands, demons arise regularly. I'd be careful if I were you.

The relaxed knight:
An unfamiliar face. New here?

The relaxed knight:
If you go into the woods, take care that you don't fall into the hands of the black lizard!
Appearances can be deceiving. Demons also appear in human forms. Even one of your very own could be possessed...

variants.name: The Room
texts:
Amazon warrior:
There are powerful demons not far from here. Be careful!

The retired knight:
Protect yourselves from the black lizard. Flee if you see him!
Demons can also take the forms of men. One of your own could be enchanted!

Amazon warrior:
Slime is nearly immune to most weapons, it's much better to attack it with sorcery.

Amazon warrior:
Normal weapons are useless against gargoyles... Sorcery is much more effective against them.

The retired knight:
